result: COMPLETE: secure-mode preload test no longer depends on where the tree lives (proves AT_SECURE first; a nosuid copy uses a directory under the temporary directory); plants, fakeroot swap root and gate rerun on the code head

gate.affected: 164 passed / 0 failed (direct); xtask test 6657+5240 passed; hot_text_products 26 passed

informational: plant preload-after-needed WARN-NO-MSG: caught by ldso_run_reads_ld_settings; cargo stops at the first failing test binary so the regex's preload test never ran
ld.so --list and LD_TRACE_LOADED_OBJECTS do not show preloads; the ld.so --preload option is not done
release notes 'Not available yet' (liella-ops): drop LD_PRELOAD when this lands

the run-2 red was /dev/shm being nosuid (set-group-ID ignored, no AT_SECURE), not the compiled-in library directory as such: the non-secure run loaded libz.so.1 whose pinned libc.so.6 resolves to <prefix>/lib

impact.what: LD_PRELOAD and /etc/ld.so.preload load objects at program start (runs 1-2; unblocks fakeroot for Aqours: swap root fakeroot-1/-2 same as the stock root)
secure preload test now runs (not fails) in a tree on a nosuid file system; plants on the preload code
Aqours package builds under fakeroot (DL-LD-PRELOAD's purpose)
one openat of <prefix>/etc/ld.so.preload per dynamic start (the reference does one access): same syscall count

improvement: plants commands that run several test binaries should pass --no-fail-fast (cargo stops at the first failing binary and the msg regex then misses); and a test that relies on set-ID must prove AT_SECURE before the case, since the plants tool's /dev/shm copy is nosuid
next_step: none for this story; coordinator drops LD_PRELOAD from the release notes' not-available list on landing
